purpose: Complete a same-record, same-future-window development comparison between r5b plus r33 instance fine-tuning and the frozen full-data PI-DeepONet baseline after r33 failed promotion to validation.
hypothesis: On the six disjoint feature-adaptation gate records, the r5b-based method will have lower physical-pressure future-field relative L2 than PI-DeepONet, while instance fine-tuning itself will remain close to its r5b parent because the r33 promotion gate failed.
primary_metric: global physical-pressure float64 energy relative L2 over every stored frame strictly after each record's second guarded onset observation
failure_signal: Sample, time-window, truth-energy, checkpoint, or source-manifest mismatch; otherwise report the measured comparison regardless of direction.

method_identity.ours: frozen r5b neural operator plus parent-residual-conditioned zero-origin instance fine-tuning
method_identity.baseline: PI-DeepONet trained on all 2240 training records for 100 epochs

interpretation_limit: This is a train-only development comparison. PI-DeepONet and r5b were both trained on these records, and r33 failed its promotion gate, so this result cannot replace frozen validation or test evidence.
decision_rule: Archive the measured result as train-only comparison evidence. Do not use it to authorize validation, test_id, or a publication claim of held-out superiority.
